title: Control Spotify playback from the terminal
summary: Use the `spotify` command-line tool to play songs or playlists, pause, skip tracks, adjust volume, and check what is currently playing.

aliases.text: play song in spotify via command line

steps.explain: Search for a song by name and start playing it.

placeholders.name: SONG_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the song you want to play

steps.explain: Search for a playlist by name and start playing it.

placeholders.name: PLAYLIST_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the playlist you want to play

steps.explain: Pause the current playback or resume if already paused.
Skip to the next song in the current playlist or queue.
Adjust the volume up, down, or to a specific value.

placeholders.name: VOLUME_ACTION
placeholders.description: Volume adjustment: 'up', 'down', or a numeric value

steps.explain: Display the current playback status and details of the playing song.
